correctness.rationale: The proof reduces by coordinate sign isometries to \(x_i\ge0\), derives the lower inequality from an arbitrary containing slice, and constructs near-optimal slice functionals from every feasible radius. The critical inequalities track the slice slack \(q=1-a(x)\), the active set \(|x_i|>r-1\), and the normalization of the constructed \(\ell_1\)-functional. Infinite support causes no hidden infinite sum in the upper construction because every active set is finite for \(r>1\), while the \(r=1\) feasible case also forces finite activity. The standard-library checker independently recovers known exact special cases and the constructive radii.
risks: The upper construction places residual functional mass on an inactive tail coordinate; the proof explicitly tracks its nonzero value through the correction term \(	au=a_kx_k\).
